The portfolio snapshot (snap_r8_fixture) contains QQQ and FCASH** positions that are not mapped to any sleeve in strategy strat_r8_v1. These unmapped holdings represent 23.18% of the portfolio value, exceeding the 15% block threshold. A full deployment draft is not allowed while unknown-sleeve exposure exceeds this threshold.

**Price data gaps — MARKET_DATA_MISSING**:
- VTI: no price bars stored in fin_price_bars. Cannot be funded without grounded market data.
- AAPL: no price bars stored in fin_price_bars. Cannot be funded without grounded market data.

No dollar-denominated lines were generated. The plan contains 0 DCA lines and 0 one-time-buy lines.

**What to do next**: The price provider returned no data at plan generation time. To resolve this, run finance.snapshot() for VTI, AAPL, and SPY to fetch and store current price bars from the provider, then regenerate the plan. The UNKNOWN_SLEEVE_EXPOSURE block requires either mapping QQQ to a strategy sleeve or accepting that only VTI and AAPL will receive DCA allocations (after resolving the price gap).

I have not invented or estimated any prices — the tool returned no price evidence and no allocation math was attempted.
